metadata.timing: median and p95 of 90 samples from 3 rotated rounds, each the mean of 5 calls
metadata.scope: CPU forward-only, preallocated outputs; API dispatch included; weight packing included; no transfer, tensor allocation, autograd or backward
metadata.limitations: One machine, 3 rounds with rotated framework order; warm-cache steady state; deterministic periodic inputs. OS scheduling, affinity and thermal state uncontrolled. C++ and Python API overhead differ. NumPy is a numerical array library, not an end-to-end neural network framework.
metadata.correctness: Each round: compared every output element against float64 reference; rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5; ReLU exact.
